6 semester hours.

    Substitutions

    Stated by the catalog on this program's requirements:

    • For pharmacy students, an unsatisfactory grade (U) in a co-op will be counted as a professional course deficiency.

    Possible equivalents for this program beyond the above — dashed means a suggestion, not a rule, and every substitution needs your advisor's approval:

    • MATH 1241 ↔ MATH 1341 (tier C)
    • MATH 1241 ↔ MATH 1245 (tier C)
